stepTitle: The inner gear of the central compound gear (yellow, $$14$$ teeth) meshes with the rightmost gear (orange, $$28$$ teeth). For every one counterclockwise rotation of the inner central (yellow) gear, how many times does the rightmost (orange) gear rotate?

figureAlts.figure3.gif: A compound gear train is arranged from left to right. The leftmost driver gear (pink, 14 teeth) meshes with the large gear of a central compound pair (blue, 42 teeth). This blue gear is fixed to the same shaft as a smaller gear (yellow, 14 teeth). The yellow gear meshes with the rightmost driven gear (orange, 28 teeth).
